items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: He had a trumpet player for a moment called Ernest Corkette.

ctx.x: He had a trumpet player for a moment called Ernest Corkette. He called himself Ernest Johnson, the black and tan band. Isn't he? Isn't he?
Isn't he? I think he's up in San Bernardino. He's dead, I think, of course. Is he dead now?
